brief_title: Exercise and GLP-1 RA on Insulin Secretion
official_title: Effects of 12 Weeks of Endurance Exercise Training Alone or in Combination With Glucagon Like Peptide 1 Receptor Agonist (GLP-1 RA) Treatment on Insulin Secretory Capacity in Type 2 Diabetes

primary_outcomes.time_frame: Change from baseline insulin secretion after Exercise intervention(12 weeks).
Change from baseline insulin secretion after 3 months of therapeutic semaglutide treatment
Change from baseline insulin secretion after 3 months of combined exercise and therapeutic semaglutide treatment

brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the effect of endurance exercise on insulin secretory capacity, alone or in addition to treatment with the glucagon-like-peptide receptor agonist semaglutide, in patients with type 2 diabetes.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes
* BMI 28-35
* Moderately preserved insulin secretory capacity (determined by glucagon test)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Insulin treatment
* Hypertension grade 3
* Heart disease
* Medical history with pancreatitis
* Diagnosed with neuropathy
* Excessive alcohol consumption
* Any condition that would interfere with the protocol.

sites.facility: Xlab, Center for Healthy Aging, Department of Biomedical Sciences, University of Copenhagen
